name: ATK_USAGE_LOGS
description: This table stores the actual log entries (USER ACTIVITY RECORDS) generated via the Usage Metrics API calls.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier  associated with the user activity log

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Session Identifier associated with the user activity log

columns.name: PAGE_URL
columns.description: Page URL where this activity was logged

columns.name: USER_AGENT
columns.description: User agent/Browser where this activity was logged.

columns.name: LOCALE
columns.description: ApplSession Locale information associated with this activity log.

columns.name: LOG_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Language Tag associated with this usage activity log

columns.name: ACCESS_MODE
columns.description: Accessibility Mode associated with this activity log

columns.name: VIEW_ID
columns.description: View ID where this activity was logged.

columns.name: TASKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Taskflow ID where this activity was logged.

columns.name: TASKFLOW_VIEWID
columns.description: View ID associated with the Taskflow Id where this activity was logged. This may be different from the VIEW_ID column.

columns.name: USER_ACTIVITY_TIME
columns.description: Time when this activity was logged.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User GUID of the user associated with this session.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Activity associated with the user activity log

columns.name: ACTIVITY_VALUE
columns.description: Activity values associated with an Activity Code. This could be a comma separated list of values or a single value.

columns.name: ECID
columns.description: Exceution Context ID for this request

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
